// Purpose: Shared compiler options for every TypeScript project in this repo.
The repo is checked by THREE projects, not one, because the three source
tsconfig.json     -> src/ + vite.config.ts + playwright.config.ts (browser: DOM + react-jsx + vite/client)
e2e/tsconfig.json     -> e2e/ (playwright: DOM for page.evaluate callbacks, no react-jsx)
`bun run typecheck` runs all three. Adding a fourth source tree without a
project to cover it is caught by scripts/typecheck-coverage.ts, which
diffs git-tracked .ts/.tsx files against the union of every project's
